translations.source_sense_description: Linguistik: einen Gegengrund (als grammatische oder semantische Kategorie) einräumend

glosses: Of, pertaining to, or being a concession; conceding.
Joining clauses while conceding some notion.
A phrase or clause that acts as a concession, such as \"even if\" or \"although\".
